notes: Prospect: AnchorForth — mid-market CCaaS targeting ecomm + fintech SMBs. They embed agent assist into their agent UI (Chrome extension + native app).
Primary ask: streaming, token-level suggestions (typeahead) with low jitter. Target: p99 suggestion latency ≤ 120ms and stable tail during spikes (holiday peaks).

Use-case specifics: real-time suggestion cards, suggested macros, automated tool-calls to ticketing (create/update Zendesk ticket), post-call summary (ticket summary + TL;DR), and confidence-based guardrails.
Quote from CTO (A. Monroe): "We need suggestions that don't slow down the agent flow — if it lags, adoption dies. Also must be able to fall back to smaller models during capacity pressure."
Security: must support customer-managed KMS and audit trails for all inference requests; data residency requirement for EU customers (some tenants must stay in eu-central).

Integration notes: websocket streaming to agent UI, add hooks for tool-calls (POST to internal ticketing API), sandbox tokens for POC. SE recommended prefix caching + KV cache to accelerate repeated contexts.
Cost sensitivity: moderate — willing to pay premium for predictable p99 and 24/7 support, but needs optimize module to recommend batching/quant profiles to hit target ARR range.

POC goals: 1) Achieve p99 ≤ 120ms with realistic agent concurrency (50 agents), 2) Demonstrate graceful fallback to smaller quantized model under 2x baseline load, 3) End-to-end tool-call success ≥ 99% on staged traffic, 4) Telemetry into Redwood Console with token-level cost breakdown.
use_case_summary: Real-time agent assist integrated in web agent UI: streaming suggestions + tool-calling to ticket system; strict tail latency SLOs for suggestion display; guardrails and confidence thresholds; per-route routing for EU residency customers.
acceptance_criteria: p99 suggestion latency ≤ 120ms under 50 concurrent agents (staging) with streaming enabled
Model fallback: automatic switch to smaller variant during >1.8x baseline load without visible UI degradation
Tool-calling: create/update ticket round-trip latency ≤ 300ms and success rate ≥ 99%
Audit logs and KMS integration validated in security review
